source.text: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is] the man who not walks in [the] counsel of wicked [people], and in [the] way of sinners not stands, and in [the] seat of mockers not sits.

en.L: How blessed [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, \q and in the way of sinners does not stand, \q and in the seat of mockers does not sit!
en.B: How blessed is {{gender:the one|the man}} who does not walk by the advice of the wicked, \q or stand on the path that sinners tread, \q or sit where mockers gather!
en.R: Life is truly good for the person who does not follow the advice of wicked people, \q does not stand on the road with sinners, \q and does not sit down with those who mock.

vi.L: Phước thay người không bước đi theo mưu kế của kẻ ác, \q không đứng trên con đường của kẻ tội lỗi, \q và không ngồi nơi chỗ ngồi của kẻ nhạo báng!
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay người không bước theo lời khuyên của kẻ ác, \q không đứng trên con đường kẻ tội lỗi đi, \q cũng không ngồi giữa đám người nhạo báng!
vi.R: Thật hạnh phúc cho người không nghe theo lời khuyên của kẻ ác, \q không đứng chung đường với kẻ có tội, \q và không ngồi chung với những kẻ chế giễu.

ko.L: 얼마나 복된가, 악인들의 꾀를 따라 걷지 않고 \q 죄인들의 길에 서지 않으며 \q 조롱하는 자들의 자리에 앉지 않는 사람은!
ko.B: 악인들의 조언대로 살지 않고 \q 죄인들이 다니는 길에 서지 않으며 \q 비웃는 자들이 모이는 자리에 앉지 않는 사람은 얼마나 복된가!
ko.R: 악한 사람들의 말을 따르지 않고, \q 죄짓는 사람들과 한길에 서지 않고, \q 바른 가르침을 비웃는 사람들과 함께 앉지 않는 사람은 참으로 행복하다.

fr.L: Ô bonheur de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui ne marche pas selon le conseil des méchants, \q et ne se tient pas sur le chemin des pécheurs, \q et ne s’assied pas sur le siège des moqueurs !
fr.B: Quel bonheur pour {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui ne vit pas selon les avis des méchants, \q qui ne s’arrête pas sur la route où vont les pécheurs \q et ne s’assied pas là où se retrouvent les moqueurs !
fr.R: Il a une vie vraiment heureuse, celui qui ne suit pas les conseils des méchants, \q qui ne reste pas sur la route avec les pécheurs, \q et qui ne s’assied pas avec ceux qui se moquent de tout.

sw.L: Heri [ni] ya mtu asiyetembea katika shauri la waovu, \q wala asiyesimama katika njia ya wenye dhambi, \q wala asiyeketi katika kiti cha wenye dharau!
sw.B: Ana heri kweli mtu asiyefuata ushauri wa waovu, \q asiyesimama katika njia wanayoipita wenye dhambi, \q wala asiyeketi mahali wanapokusanyika wenye dharau!
sw.R: Maisha ni mazuri kweli kwa mtu asiyefuata ushauri wa watu waovu, \q asiyesimama njiani pamoja na wenye dhambi, \q wala asiyeketi pamoja na watu wanaodhihaki.

es.L: ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} que no anda en el consejo de los malvados, \q y en el camino de los pecadores no se detiene, \q y en el asiento de los burlones no se sienta!
es.B: ¡Qué {{gender:dichosa es la persona|dichoso es el hombre}} que no se guía por el consejo de los malvados, \q ni se para en la senda que pisan los pecadores, \q ni se sienta donde se reúnen los burlones!
es.R: Qué buena es la vida de quien no sigue los consejos de los malvados, \q no se queda en el camino con los pecadores \q y no se sienta con los que se burlan.

pt.L: Bem-aventurado [é] {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} que não caminha no conselho dos ímpios, \q e no caminho dos pecadores não se põe de pé, \q e no assento dos zombadores não se senta!
pt.B: Como é feliz {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} que não se guia pelo conselho dos ímpios, \q nem fica parado na trilha que os pecadores percorrem, \q nem se senta onde os zombadores se reúnem!
pt.R: Feliz de verdade é quem não segue os conselhos de gente má, \q não fica no caminho junto com os pecadores \q e não se senta com os que vivem zombando.

am.L: ምስጉን ነው በኃጥኣን ምክር የማይሄድ ሰው፣ \q በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ የማይቆም፣ \q በፌዘኞችም መቀመጫ የማይቀመጥ!
am.B: የተባረከ ነው በክፉዎች ምክር የማይመራ ሰው፣ \q ኃጢአተኞች በሚሄዱበት ጎዳና የማይቆም፣ \q ፌዘኞችም በሚሰበሰቡበት የማይቀመጥ!
am.R: የክፉ ሰዎችን ምክር የማይከተል ሰው በእውነት ደስተኛ ነው፤ \q ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር በመንገድ አይቆምም፤ \q ከሚያፌዙ ሰዎችም ጋር አይቀመጥም።

hi.L: कितना धन्य [है] वह {{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}} जो दुष्टों की सम्मति में नहीं चलता, \q और पापियों के मार्ग में खड़ा नहीं होता, \q और ठट्ठा करनेवालों की बैठक में नहीं बैठता!
hi.B: कितना धन्य है वह {{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}} जो दुष्टों की सलाह पर नहीं चलता, \q न उस मार्ग पर खड़ा होता है जिस पर पापी चलते हैं, \q न वहाँ बैठता है जहाँ ठट्ठा करनेवाले जमा होते हैं!
hi.R: उस व्यक्ति का जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है जो दुष्ट लोगों की सलाह पर नहीं चलता, \q पापियों के साथ उनके रास्ते पर खड़ा नहीं होता, \q और मज़ाक़ उड़ानेवालों के साथ नहीं बैठता।

ru.L: Блажен {{gender:человек|муж}}, который не ходит по совету нечестивых, \q и на пути грешников не стоит, \q и на месте насмешников не сидит!
ru.B: Блажен тот, кто не следует советам нечестивых, \q не стоит на пути, которым идут грешники, \q не сидит там, где собираются насмешники!
ru.R: Счастлив человек, который не слушается советов злых людей, \q не стоит на одной дороге с грешниками \q и не садится рядом с теми, кто насмехается.

ja.L: 幸いなことよ、悪しき者たちの助言のうちを歩まず、 \q 罪人たちの道に立たず、 \q 嘲る者たちの座に着かない人は！
ja.B: なんと幸いなことか、悪しき者たちの助言に従って歩まず、 \q 罪人たちの踏み行く道に立たず、 \q 嘲る者たちの集う所に座らない人は！
ja.R: 悪い人たちの助言に従わず、 \q 罪を犯す人たちと同じ道に立たず、 \q 人をばかにする者たちと一緒に座らない人は、本当に幸せだ。

uk.L: {{gender:Блаженна людина|Блаженний чоловік}}, що не ходить за порадою нечестивих, \q і на шляху грішників не стоїть, \q і на місці насмішників не сидить!
uk.B: {{gender:Блаженна та людина|Блаженний той чоловік}}, що не живе за порадами нечестивих, \q не зупиняється на стежці, якою ходять грішники, \q і не сідає там, де збираються насмішники!
uk.R: Справді добре живеться тій людині, що не слухає порад злих людей, \q не стоїть на дорозі разом із грішниками \q і не сідає з тими, хто насміхається.

decisions.choice: How blessed: an exclamation about a life that goes well
decisions.reason: The word ('ashre) is an exclamation, plural in form: "oh, the blessings of ...". It speaks of the well-being of a person whose life is in step with God (Proverbs 3:13; Deuteronomy 33:29). It is not the word for being blessed by God (baruk, Genesis 12:2), and it is more than a passing feeling of happiness. Psalm 2 ends with the same word (2:12), so the two psalms open and close together.

decisions.choice: the man: anyone who lives this way
decisions.reason: The word is "man" ('ish) with the article: the psalm draws a portrait of a type of person and sets this one against "the wicked" as a group (verses 4-6). The blessing is for everyone who lives this way, "all who take refuge in him" (2:12). Some also see here the king who is to read God's instruction all his life (Deuteronomy 17:18-20), which ties the psalm to Psalm 2; that does not narrow who may live this way.

decisions.choice: walk, stand, sit: three steps deeper in
decisions.reason: The verbs move from walking along, to standing still, to sitting down, and the places from the advice of the wicked, to the path of sinners, to the seat of mockers: a life drawn further and further in. The blessed person takes none of these steps. The verbs are in the Hebrew past form, used for what is always true, so they are rendered in the present.

decisions.choice: counsel: advice, plans
decisions.reason: The word ('etsah) means advice or a plan. To walk in someone's counsel is to live by it.

decisions.choice: mockers: people who scorn wisdom and correction
decisions.reason: In Proverbs the mocker (lets) is the one who will not listen to correction and sneers at what is good (Proverbs 9:7-8; 13:1; 21:24). It is the last and worst of the three.

decisions.choice: How blessed
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the exclamation with "How", and "blessed" because the word speaks of a life that is truly good, not only of a feeling (m1).

decisions.choice: Life is truly good for
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word means (m1), since "blessed" can sound like church language and "happy" like a passing mood. 2:12 says the same.

decisions.choice: the person (L), the one (B); "the man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word is masculine but describes anyone who lives this way (m2), so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default. Readable says "the person", which needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: "Phước thay" (L), "Phước hạnh thay" (B); "Thật hạnh phúc cho" (R)
decisions.reason: The exclamation is about a life that goes well. "Phước thay" keeps the short cry of the Hebrew; Readable uses the everyday "hạnh phúc" (happy, well off), as the English Readable says "Life is truly good".

decisions.choice: "người" (a person) with no gender span; "người ấy" for him through the psalm
alternatives: gender spans as in the English ("người đàn ông" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: "người" already means anyone, man or woman, and "người ấy" is the plain pronoun for it, so Vietnamese has no second form for a gender setting to switch to. The English spans in 1:1-3 have no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: The exclamation "얼마나 복된가" (L, B) comes first and "사람은" (the person) last, after the three relative clauses
decisions.reason: Korean puts a relative clause before its noun, so "the person" cannot stand at the head of the verse as in the Hebrew; the three clauses keep the Hebrew's order (walk, stand, sit) and each line keeps its own colon. Literal and Balanced keep the exclamation ("How blessed") at the head as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "사람" (person) with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "the man" as an alternative. Korean "사람" is the ordinary word for a person of either sex and is what Korean says for the Hebrew here, so Korean has no second wording to offer (style guide section 7). The same holds for "그" (that person) in verses 2-3.

decisions.choice: "Ô bonheur de" (Literal), "Quel bonheur pour" (Balanced), "Il a une vie vraiment heureuse, celui qui" (Readable), for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is an exclamation in the plural, "oh, the blessings of" (m1). "Ô bonheur de" keeps the exclamation and the plural sense at Literal; Balanced and Readable say it as natural French exclamations. "Bienheureux" now sounds churchly, and "Heureux l'homme" is the wording of the familiar versions.

decisions.choice: "l'être humain" with "l'homme" as the alternative; the following verses then say "il", "son" with no span; Readable says "celui qui"
alternatives: "la personne", which would need "elle" in verses 2-3
decisions.reason: The psalm draws a portrait that fits anyone (m2). French needs the setting only on the noun: "l'être humain" is masculine like "l'homme", so the "il" and "son" of verses 2-3 read naturally with either option, where English needs "they"/"he" spans. "Celui qui" at Readable already means anyone.

decisions.choice: "Heri [ni] ya" (L); "Ana heri kweli" (B); "Maisha ni mazuri kweli kwa" (R)
decisions.reason: "Heri" is the Swahili word for the well-being of a life that goes right, which is what the Hebrew exclamation means (m1); "amebarikiwa" would sound like the different word for being blessed by God, and "furaha" is only a feeling. Readable says plainly what "heri" means, as the English Readable does. The same wording is used wherever this exclamation comes in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "mtu" (a person), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Mtu" already means any person, man or woman, which is what the psalm means (m2); the only other choice, "mwanamume", would narrow the meaning. So the Swahili has no gender span here or in the rest of these psalms, where the English has one.

decisions.choice: dichoso
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ashre ("how blessed") describes a life that goes well with God. "Dichoso" is the everyday Spanish word, as in Proverbs and the beatitudes; "bienaventurado" is older church language. The adjective agrees with its noun, so the gender setting takes in "Dichosa la persona" and "Dichoso el hombre" together.

decisions.choice: Qué buena es la vida de quien
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "Life is truly good for", Readable says that this person's life is good, not only that the person feels happy. The same wording is used for ashre in the rest of these psalms at Readable.

decisions.choice: Bem-aventurado (L); Como é feliz (B); Feliz de verdade (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book of Psalms ('ashre, m1). Literal says "bem-aventurado", the Portuguese word for this exclamation and for the Beatitudes, as Job 5:17 has it. Balanced and Readable say "feliz", the plain word, with "Como é" to keep the exclamation (B) and "de verdade" (R) for the English Readable's "truly good", so that it is not heard as a passing mood. "Abençoado" would be one who has received a blessing (baruk), which m1 rules out. "Feliz" has one form for a man or a woman, so the inclusive default reads naturally; Readable's "quem" is already inclusive and needs no span.

decisions.choice: os ímpios (L, B); gente má, as pessoas más (R); os pecadores (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "o ímpio", "os ímpios" for the wicked (resha'im) at Literal and Balanced, the usual Portuguese word for people who live against God, and "o justo", "os justos" for the righteous (1:5-6); Readable says "gente má", "as pessoas más" where the English Readable says "wicked people", and "quem faz o que é certo" where it says "those who do right".

decisions.choice: How blessed (ʾashrei) as "ምስጉን ነው" (L), "የተባረከ ነው" (B), "በእውነት ደስተኛ ነው" (R), with the exclamation put first at L and B as the Hebrew does
decisions.reason: The terms list for the Psalms gives one word per level: "ምስጉን" keeps the exclamation of a life that goes well, "የተባረከ" is the plain modern word, and Readable says it in everyday words, as the English "Life is truly good". The Ge'ez "ብፁዕ" is the church word but not current Amharic. Psalm 2:12 closes with the same words.

decisions.choice: "ሰው" (a person) with no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English one
decisions.reason: Amharic "ሰው" already means any person, man or woman, and the generic masculine verb forms that follow (verses 2-3) are inclusive, so there is nothing for the setting to change; the English span has no Amharic counterpart in this psalm.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}" for the name YHWH; "प्रभु" also for the title Adonai
decisions.reason: In Hindi "प्रभु" stands both for the divine name YHWH ("the LORD") and for the title Adonai ("the Lord", as in 2:4). Wherever the Hebrew has the name, the text carries the divine_name setting, whose alternative "याहवे" gives the name itself; with it on, a reader can tell the two apart, because only the name changes. God takes honorific plural agreement in both options, as in the earlier books of this translation. "यहोवा" is not used. This holds for the whole book of Psalms.

decisions.choice: "कितना धन्य है" (L, B); "... का जीवन सचमुच अच्छा है" (R)
decisions.reason: The exclamation (ashrei) speaks of a life that truly goes well (meaning m1). Literal and Balanced say "धन्य", the word of the beatitudes and of Romans 4:7-8 (Psalm 32:1-2) in this translation; Readable says what the word means, as the English does, since "ख़ुश" sounds like a passing mood. This wording holds wherever the psalms have ashrei (2:12 and later).

decisions.choice: "दुष्टों की सम्मति" (L), "दुष्टों की सलाह" (B, R); "मार्ग" (L, B), "रास्ता" (R); "ठट्ठा करनेवाले" (L, B), "मज़ाक़ उड़ानेवाले" (R)
decisions.reason: Counsel is advice and plans (meaning m4): Literal keeps the weightier "सम्मति", Balanced and Readable the everyday "सलाह". The way, a whole way of life (1:6), is "मार्ग" at Literal and Balanced and "रास्ता" or "जीवन" at Readable as the English level says it. Mockers are "ठट्ठा करनेवाले", the word the Proverbs note gives for those who scorn correction (meaning m5). These forms hold through the psalms.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}}"
decisions.reason: As in the English, the masculine word describes anyone who lives this way (meaning m2), so the gender setting offers "व्यक्ति" by default and "आदमी", as James 1:12 in this translation. Readable says "व्यक्ति" with no span, as the English says "the person". The pronoun "वह" in verses 2-3 is the same for a man or a woman, so the Hindi needs no span where the English has one there.

decisions.choice: Блажен (L, B); Счастлив (R)
decisions.reason: Settled for the Psalms: ashrei is "Блажен" at Literal and Balanced, "Счастлив" at Readable, the forms the Russian New Testament uses for the same word in the Beatitudes and in Romans 4:7-8 (Psalm 32:1-2). "Блажен" is itself an exclamation, so "Как" is not added; Readable "Счастлив" says that life goes well for this person (m1), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:человек|муж}} (L), as James 1:12; тот (B) and человек (R) with no span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "man" means anyone who lives this way (m2). Russian "человек" and "тот, кто" already include everyone, so Balanced and Readable need no setting and the later "он", "его" for this person need none either; Literal offers the traditional "муж" as the alternative, as James 1:12 does in this translation.

decisions.choice: по совету нечестивых (L), советам нечестивых (B), советов злых людей (R); путь (L, B), дорога (R)
decisions.reason: The counsel is advice and plans (m4), not a council meeting, so Russian says "по совету", "советам". "Нечестивые" (L, B) and "злые люди" (R) are the Psalms' fixed words for the wicked. "Путь" is the Psalms' word for a way of life at Literal and Balanced (1:6); Readable says "дорога" here and "жизнь" in 1:6, as the English does. The seat of mockers is "место насмешников", where mockers gather.

decisions.choice: Plain style (だ・である) at every level, Readable too, for the whole Psalter: no です・ます anywhere, wishes and blessings as 〜ように (not 〜ますように). God spoken of in the third person is DN / 神 / 主 / その方, never 彼, with light respect forms (知っておられる, 答えられる, R 〜てくださる); God addressed is あなた, and a request to God is 〜てください (3:8).
alternatives: requests as 〜てほしい, as Job and Lamentations
decisions.reason: The Psalms are poetry, and OT_SUPPLEMENT gives poetry the plain voice at every level, as David's song (2 Samuel 22), the psalm of 1 Chronicles 16, Job, Proverbs and Lamentations have it. Requests take 〜てください, the form Japanese prayer uses inside plain speech, as Numbers 10:35 and 1 Chronicles 16:35 (= Psalm 106:47) already have it.

decisions.choice: 'ashre "幸いなことよ" (L), "なんと幸いなことか" (B), "本当に幸せだ" (R); resha'im "悪しき者" (L, B), "悪い人" (R); chatta'im "罪人" (L, B), "罪を犯す人" (R); letsim "嘲る者" (L, B), "人をばかにする者" (R); 'etsah "助言": all as in Proverbs, for the whole Psalter
decisions.reason: The wisdom words keep the forms Proverbs settled (PRO 3:13, 1:7-22), so the Psalter and Proverbs read as one translation; 'ashre is the exclamation of m1, kept apart from barukh / barakh (祝福する, ほめたたえる).

decisions.choice: "нечестиві" (L, B), "злі люди" (R) for the wicked, through the book
decisions.reason: "Нечестиві" names people who live with no regard for God, as the Hebrew does; "безбожні" now suggests unbelief as an opinion. Readable says it plainly, as the English "wicked people".

decisions.choice: "Блаженна людина" (L, B); "Справді добре живеться" (R)
decisions.reason: The cry of how well someone fares is "блаженний" at L and B, the word of the Beatitudes in the Ukrainian Gospels; Readable says it in everyday words, as the English does. The gender setting chooses "людина" or "чоловік", with the agreeing adjective inside the span.

source.text: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: But rather in [the] instruction of YHWH [is] his delight, and in his instruction he murmurs by day and night.

en.L: But in the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{gender:their|his}} delight, \q and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} instruction {{gender:they murmur|he murmurs}} day and night.
en.B: Instead, the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is {{gender:their|his}} delight, \q and {{gender:they recite it quietly to themselves|he recites it quietly to himself}} day and night.
en.R: Instead, that person loves {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s teaching and repeats it, thinking about it day and night.

vi.L: Nhưng niềm vui thích của người ấy [ở] trong sự dạy dỗ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và người ấy lẩm nhẩm sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngày và đêm.
vi.B: Trái lại, người ấy vui thích trong lời dạy dỗ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và ngày đêm khẽ đọc lời ấy cho chính mình.
vi.R: Trái lại, người ấy yêu thích lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ngày đêm đọc đi đọc lại, suy nghĩ về lời ấy.

ko.L: 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침에 그의 기쁨이 [있고], \q 그분의 가르침을 그가 낮과 밤에 읊조린다.
ko.B: 오히려 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 기뻐하며, \q 그 가르침을 낮이나 밤이나 나지막이 되뇐다.
ko.R: 오히려 그 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 좋아해서, 밤낮으로 그 가르침을 되뇌며 깊이 생각한다.

fr.L: Mais plutôt, dans la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] son plaisir, \q et dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} loi il murmure jour et nuit.
fr.B: Au contraire, l’instruction {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait sa joie, \q et il la redit à mi-voix jour et nuit.
fr.R: Au contraire, il aime l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : il le répète et y pense jour et nuit.

sw.L: Bali katika sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndiyo] furaha yake, \q na katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} huinong'ona mchana na usiku.
sw.B: Badala yake, mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiyo furaha yake, \q naye huyasoma kwa sauti ya chini mchana na usiku.
sw.R: Badala yake, mtu huyo anayapenda mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuyarudia, akiyafikiri mchana na usiku.

es.L: sino que en la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] su deleite, \q y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} instrucción murmura de día y de noche.
es.B: Al contrario, la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es su alegría, \q y la recita en voz baja de día y de noche.
es.R: Al contrario, esa persona ama la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la repite, pensando en ella de día y de noche.

pt.L: Mas no ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [está] o seu prazer, \q e no ensino {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} murmura dia e noite.
pt.B: Pelo contrário, a sua alegria é o ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q e dia e noite o repete em voz baixa.
pt.R: Pelo contrário, essa pessoa ama os ensinamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os repete, pensando neles dia e noite.

am.L: ነገር ግን ደስታው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ሕግ [ነው]፤ \q ሕጉንም ቀንና ሌሊት ያነበንባል።
am.B: ይልቁንም ደስታው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ሕግ ነው፤ \q ቀንና ሌሊትም ሕጉን በለሆሳስ ያነበዋል።
am.R: ይልቁንም ያ ሰው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትምህርት ይወዳል፤ ቀንና ሌሊትም እየደጋገመ ያስብበታል።

hi.L: पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की व्यवस्था में उसकी प्रसन्नता [है], \q और उनकी व्यवस्था को वह दिन और रात बुदबुदाता रहता है।
hi.B: बल्कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की व्यवस्था उसे प्रिय है, \q और वह दिन और रात धीमे स्वर में उसे दोहराता रहता है।
hi.R: बल्कि वह व्यक्ति {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शिक्षा से प्रेम करता है, और दिन-रात उसे दोहराता और उस पर सोचता रहता है।

ru.L: Но в Законе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — его отрада, \q и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Закон он шепчет [про себя] днём и ночью.
ru.B: Напротив, Закон {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — его радость, \q и он тихо повторяет его про себя днём и ночью.
ru.R: Нет, этот человек любит наставление {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, повторяет его и размышляет о нём днём и ночью.

ja.L: そうではなく、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えに、その人の喜びがあり、 \q その方の教えを、昼も夜も口ずさむ。
ja.B: むしろ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えを喜びとし、 \q 昼も夜も、それを小声で唱える。
ja.R: そうではなく、その人は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えが大好きで、昼も夜もそれを繰り返し口にしては、よく考える。

uk.L: Але в настанові {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} — {{gender:її|його}} втіха, \q і над {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} настановою {{gender:вона|він}} шепоче вдень і вночі.
uk.B: Навпаки, настанова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} — {{gender:її|його}} радість, \q і {{gender:вона|він}} стиха повторює її собі вдень і вночі.
uk.R: Навпаки, ця людина любить навчання {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і повторює його, роздумуючи над ним вдень і вночі.

decisions.choice: instruction: the LORD's teaching
decisions.reason: Torah means teaching or instruction (Proverbs 1:8; 3:1). Here it is the LORD's instruction, which his people had in writing in the Law of Moses (Joshua 1:8 also speaks of meditating on it day and night). It includes commands, but it is wider than rules: it is something to delight in.

decisions.choice: murmurs: reads or repeats the words under the breath
decisions.reason: The verb (hagah) is used for a low sound: the moan of a dove (Isaiah 38:14), the growl of a lion over its prey (Isaiah 31:4), and words spoken half aloud. In the ancient world meditation was usually done aloud, reading or repeating the words in a low voice. The same verb returns in 2:1, where the peoples "murmur" empty plans.

decisions.choice: But rather: the strong contrast after three "not"s
decisions.reason: The two small words (ki 'im) together mean "but on the contrary". After three things the blessed person does not do, the psalm says what fills that person's life instead.

decisions.choice: instruction (L, B); teaching (R)
decisions.reason: "Law" is the familiar word here, but it suggests rules alone; "instruction" keeps the wider sense of the Hebrew word (m1).

decisions.choice: murmur (L); recite quietly (B); repeat and think about (R)
decisions.reason: "Meditate" now often means silent thought, but the Hebrew verb is about words said under the breath (m2). Readable keeps both the repeating and the thinking.

decisions.choice: their, they (with "his", "he" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The person of verse 1 stands for anyone who lives this way (1:1, m2), so the pronouns follow the gender setting. Readable avoids the pronoun with "that person".

decisions.choice: "sự dạy dỗ" (L), "lời dạy dỗ" (B), "lời dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the LORD's instruction, his teaching as a whole (see the meaning decision). "luật pháp", the familiar word, makes it sound like a legal code; "lời dạy" keeps the sense of teaching that a person loves and repeats.

decisions.choice: "lẩm nhẩm" (L); "khẽ đọc ... cho chính mình" (B); "đọc đi đọc lại, suy nghĩ về" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is reading or saying words under the breath. "suy gẫm" (meditate) names only the thinking; "lẩm nhẩm" and "khẽ đọc" keep the sound of the words, and Readable adds the thinking that goes with it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: YHWH is {{divine_name:주|야훼}} at every level, with the particle outside the span ({{divine_name:주|야훼}}의, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서)
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a): "주" (Lord) by default, the name "야훼" as the alternative, as the English has "the LORD|Yahweh". "여호와", the form of the older Protestant Bibles, is not used. Both forms end in a vowel, so one particle fits both. This holds for the whole Psalter.

decisions.choice: "가르침" (teaching, instruction) at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (torah) is the LORD's teaching (meaning decision m1); "율법" is the familiar church word but in Korean it says a law code, which narrows the sense here.

decisions.choice: God's torah: "la loi" (Literal), "l'instruction" (Balanced), "l'enseignement" (Readable), for Psalms and Proverbs
decisions.reason: The word means the LORD's teaching and direction (m1), not only a code of laws. Literal keeps the traditional "la loi"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, as the English does with "instruction" and "teaching".

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals for the name YHWH, with "Yahvé" as the alternative, for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch: capitals mark the divine name as the English "the LORD" does. "L'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the other form a reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: "sheria" for the LORD's torah at Literal; "mafundisho" (teaching) at Balanced and Readable, through the Psalms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew torah is the LORD's instruction (m1). "Sheria" is the familiar word and keeps the link with the Law of Moses at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "mafundisho", because "sheria" on its own sounds like rules and courts, while the psalm speaks of teaching a person delights in.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}
decisions.reason: God's name YHWH is "el SEÑOR" in capitals by default, as in the rest of the Spanish Old Testament, with "Yahvé" as the reader's alternative. The span takes in the article and its contraction (del SEÑOR, al SEÑOR); in address it is "SEÑOR" alone.

decisions.choice: instrucción (L, B); enseñanza (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew torah here is the LORD's teaching for life, not a law code only. Literal and Balanced say "instrucción", as the English says "instruction"; Readable says "enseñanza". "Ley" is the familiar older word, but it narrows the sense.

decisions.choice: o ensino (L, B); os ensinamentos (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: torah is "o ensino" where the English says "instruction" and "os ensinamentos" where it says "teaching" (m1). "A lei" is the familiar Portuguese word here, but like English "law" it suggests rules alone; where the English of a later psalm says "law", Portuguese says "a lei".

decisions.choice: "o seu prazer", "a sua alegria" and a verb without a subject, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "their/his" under the gender setting. Portuguese "seu", "sua" and a verb with no subject pronoun are the same for a man or a woman, so there is nothing for the setting to change here; the person of verse 1 carries the span. Readable says "essa pessoa", as the English Readable says "that person".

decisions.choice: instruction (torah) as "ሕግ" (L, B), "ትምህርት" (teaching, R); murmurs as "ያነበንባል" (L), "በለሆሳስ ያነበዋል" (B), "እየደጋገመ ያስብበታል" (R)
decisions.reason: "ሕግ" is the word used for torah through the Psalms (Psalm 119). The verb pictures reading the words half aloud, so the Amharic says reciting under the breath rather than silent thinking, except at Readable, which follows the English "repeats it, thinking about it".

decisions.choice: "व्यवस्था" (L, B); "शिक्षा" (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's torah is his instruction (meaning m1). Literal and Balanced keep "व्यवस्था", the word for God's law in the New Testament and the Pentateuch of this translation; Readable says "शिक्षा" (teaching), as the poetry note settles, so that it is not heard as a code of rules alone.

decisions.choice: "बुदबुदाता रहता है" (L); "धीमे स्वर में दोहराता रहता है" (B); "दोहराता और उस पर सोचता रहता है" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is about words said under the breath (meaning m2), so the Hindi avoids "ध्यान", which suggests silent meditation. Readable keeps both the repeating and the thinking, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "उनकी" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). Respect for God is carried by the honorific plural, as in the earlier books. This holds for this whole psalm and wherever the English has such a span in the following psalms.

decisions.choice: Закон (L, B); наставление (R)
decisions.reason: Settled for the Psalms: God's torah is "Закон", capitalised as in the Russian New Testament, at Literal and Balanced, and "наставление" at Readable, which says that it is teaching and not rules alone (m1), as the English Readable's "teaching" does.

decisions.choice: шепчет [про себя] (L); тихо повторяет про себя (B); повторяет и размышляет (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is about words said under the breath (m2); "размышляет" alone would make it silent thought. Readable keeps both the repeating and the thinking, as the English does.

decisions.choice: torat YHWH "DNの教え" at every level, for the whole Psalter (19:8, 119)
decisions.reason: m1 reads torah as the LORD's teaching, not a law code, and the English has instruction / teaching; 教え is the word Proverbs uses for torah, and 律法 would point the reader to the Law of Moses alone.

decisions.choice: "その人" or no pronoun, with no gender span, where the English has their / his spans
decisions.reason: Japanese その人 already covers a man or a woman, so no setting is needed; this holds through Psalm 1 (1:1 人, 1:3 その人) and the Psalter, as in Proverbs and Job.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ" (default) and "Ягве" (alternative), inflected inside each option of the divine_name span, for the divine name through the book
decisions.reason: The capitals mirror the English "the LORD" and keep the name apart from Adonai, "Господь"; the setting shows the name itself as "Ягве", with г for the Hebrew h as Ukrainian transcribes it.

decisions.choice: "настанова" (L, B), "навчання" (R) for the LORD's torah, through the book
decisions.reason: The English reads torah here as instruction, not a legal code; "Закон" would suggest the code of Moses alone. Psalm 119 keeps the same word.

source.text: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ׀יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he is like a tree transplanted by channels of water, which its fruit gives in its season, and its leaf not withers, and all that he does succeeds.

en.L: And {{gender:that person is|he is}} like a tree transplanted by channels of water, \q which gives its fruit in its season, \q and its leaf does not wither; \q and all that {{gender:they do|he does}} succeeds.
en.B: {{gender:That person is|He is}} like a tree set out beside channels of water, \q which bears its fruit when its season comes, \q and whose leaves never dry up. \q Whatever {{gender:they do|he does}} turns out well.
en.R: That person is like a tree planted beside streams of water. \q It gives its fruit at the right time, \q and its leaves do not dry up. \q Everything that person does goes well.

vi.L: Và người ấy như cây được trồng bên các dòng nước, \q sinh trái mình theo mùa của nó, \q và lá nó không héo; \q và mọi việc người ấy làm đều thành công.
vi.B: Người ấy như cây được trồng bên những dòng nước chảy, \q đến mùa thì kết trái, \q lá không bao giờ khô. \q Việc gì người ấy làm cũng đều thành công.
vi.R: Người ấy giống như cây trồng bên những dòng suối. \q Cây ấy ra trái đúng lúc, \q và lá của nó không bị khô. \q Người ấy làm việc gì cũng tốt đẹp.

ko.L: 그는 물길들 곁에 옮겨 심은 나무와 같아서, \q 제철에 그 열매를 내고 \q 그 잎이 시들지 않으니, \q 그가 하는 모든 일이 잘된다.
ko.B: 그는 물길 곁에 심긴 나무와 같아서, \q 철이 되면 열매를 맺고 \q 잎이 마르는 일이 없다. \q 그가 하는 일은 무엇이든 잘된다.
ko.R: 그런 사람은 물가에 심은 나무와 같다. \q 그 나무는 때가 되면 열매를 맺고, \q 잎이 마르지 않는다. \q 그 사람이 하는 일은 다 잘된다.

fr.L: Et il est comme un arbre transplanté près de canaux d’eau, \q qui donne son fruit en sa saison, \q et dont le feuillage ne se fane pas ; \q et tout ce qu’il fait réussit.
fr.B: Il est comme un arbre mis en terre au bord des canaux d’eau, \q qui porte son fruit quand vient sa saison \q et dont les feuilles ne sèchent jamais. \q Tout ce qu’il entreprend aboutit.
fr.R: Il ressemble à un arbre planté au bord des ruisseaux. \q Il donne ses fruits au bon moment, \q et ses feuilles ne sèchent pas. \q Tout ce que fait cette personne réussit.

sw.L: Naye [yu] kama mti uliopandikizwa kando ya mifereji ya maji, \q unaotoa tunda lake kwa msimu wake, \q na majani yake hayakauki; \q na yote anayoyafanya yanafanikiwa.
sw.B: Mtu huyo ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya mifereji ya maji, \q unaozaa matunda msimu wake unapofika, \q na ambao majani yake hayakauki kamwe. \q Lolote analolifanya linamwendea vizuri.
sw.R: Mtu huyo ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya vijito vya maji. \q Unatoa matunda yake kwa wakati unaofaa, \q na majani yake hayakauki. \q Kila jambo analofanya mtu huyo linafanikiwa.

es.L: Y es como un árbol trasplantado junto a corrientes de agua, \q que da su fruto a su tiempo, \q y su hoja no se marchita; \q y todo lo que hace tiene éxito.
es.B: Es como un árbol plantado junto a canales de agua, \q que da su fruto cuando llega su tiempo \q y cuyas hojas nunca se secan. \q Todo lo que emprende le sale bien.
es.R: Esa persona es como un árbol plantado junto a arroyos. \q Da su fruto en el momento justo, \q y sus hojas no se secan. \q Todo lo que esa persona hace le sale bien.

pt.L: E é como uma árvore transplantada junto a canais de água, \q que dá o seu fruto no seu tempo, \q e a sua folha não murcha; \q e tudo o que faz tem êxito.
pt.B: Essa pessoa é como uma árvore posta junto a canais de água, \q que dá o seu fruto quando chega a estação \q e cujas folhas nunca secam. \q Tudo o que faz dá certo.
pt.R: Essa pessoa é como uma árvore plantada perto de riachos. \q Ela dá frutos na época certa, \q e as suas folhas não secam. \q Tudo o que essa pessoa faz vai bem.

am.L: እርሱም በውኃ ቦዮች አጠገብ ተዛውሮ እንደ ተተከለ ዛፍ ነው፤ \q ፍሬውን በወቅቱ የሚሰጥ፣ \q ቅጠሉም የማይጠወልግ፤ \q የሚያደርገውም ሁሉ ይሳካለታል።
am.B: እርሱ በውኃ ቦዮች ዳር እንደ ተተከለ ዛፍ ነው፤ \q ወቅቱ ሲደርስ ፍሬውን ያፈራል፤ \q ቅጠሉም ከቶ አይደርቅም። \q የሚያደርገው ሁሉ መልካም ይሆንለታል።
am.R: ያ ሰው በውኃ ጅረቶች አጠገብ እንደ ተተከለ ዛፍ ነው። \q በትክክለኛው ጊዜ ፍሬ ይሰጣል፤ \q ቅጠሉም አይደርቅም። \q ያ ሰው የሚሠራው ሁሉ ይሳካለታል።

hi.L: और वह उस पेड़ के समान [है] जो जल की नालियों के किनारे रोपा गया है, \q जो अपनी ऋतु में अपना फल देता है, \q और उसका पत्ता नहीं मुरझाता; \q और जो कुछ वह करता है, सफल होता है।
hi.B: वह उस पेड़ के समान है जो जल की नालियों के किनारे लगाया गया हो, \q जो अपनी ऋतु आने पर फल देता है, \q और जिसके पत्ते कभी नहीं सूखते। \q जो कुछ वह करता है, उसमें सफल होता है।
hi.R: वह व्यक्ति उस पेड़ जैसा है जो पानी की धाराओं के किनारे लगाया गया हो। \q वह सही समय पर फल देता है, \q और उसके पत्ते नहीं सूखते। \q उस व्यक्ति के सब काम सफल होते हैं।

ru.L: И он — как дерево, пересаженное к протокам вод, \q что даёт свой плод в своё время, \q и листва его не увядает; \q и всё, что он делает, удаётся.
ru.B: Такой человек — как дерево, высаженное у водных каналов, \q которое приносит плод, когда приходит его пора, \q и листья которого никогда не засыхают. \q Всё, что он делает, ему удаётся.
ru.R: Такой человек — как дерево, посаженное у ручьёв. \q Оно даёт плоды в нужное время, \q и его листья не сохнут. \q Всё, что этот человек делает, получается хорошо.

ja.L: そして、その人は、水の流れのほとりに移し植えられた木のようである。 \q それは時が来るとその実を結び、 \q その葉はしおれない。 \q そして、その人の行うことは、すべて成し遂げられる。
ja.B: その人は、水路のそばに植えられた木のようだ。 \q 季節が来れば実を結び、 \q 葉は決して枯れることがない。 \q その人のすることは、何でもうまくいく。
ja.R: その人は、川のそばに植えられた木のようだ。 \q ちょうどよい時に実をつけ、 \q 葉が枯れることもない。 \q その人のすることは、何でもうまくいく。

uk.L: І {{gender:вона|він}} як дерево, пересаджене над потоками води, \q що дає свій плід своєї пори, \q і листя його не вʼяне; \q і все, що {{gender:вона|він}} робить, вдається.
uk.B: {{gender:Вона|Він}} — як дерево, посаджене біля водних потоків, \q що родить плід, коли настає його пора, \q і чиє листя ніколи не всихає. \q Усе, що {{gender:вона|він}} робить, має добрий кінець.
uk.R: Ця людина — як дерево, посаджене біля струмків. \q Воно дає плоди вчасно, \q і листя його не засихає. \q Усе, що робить ця людина, вдається.

decisions.choice: transplanted: planted on purpose where it will thrive
decisions.reason: The verb (shatal) is used for planting something in a chosen place where it will grow well (Jeremiah 17:8; Ezekiel 17:8). The tree did not spring up by the water by chance; someone set it there.

decisions.choice: channels of water: streams that water an orchard
decisions.reason: The word (peleg) is used for channels or streams of water, the kind that kept trees alive in a dry land (Isaiah 32:2). Jeremiah 17:7-8 uses the same picture for the person who trusts in the LORD.

decisions.choice: all that he does succeeds: the person, not the tree
alternatives: all that it produces thrives (still the tree)
decisions.reason: The last line leaves the picture and speaks of the person again: Joshua 1:8 uses the same verb for the success of the one who keeps the LORD's instruction. The verb can mean "it succeeds" or "he makes it succeed"; either way the person's life turns out well. Some read the line as still describing the tree, whose every leaf and fruit thrives.

decisions.choice: set out beside
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the sense of a tree placed there on purpose (m1).

decisions.choice: they / that person, with "he" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The verbs refer back to the person of verse 1, who stands for anyone who lives this way, so they follow the gender setting. Readable says "that person".

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: Where the English has "that person" or "they" with "he" as the alternative, the Spanish verb and "su" already say nothing about whether the person is a man or a woman, so no gender setting is needed. This holds throughout these psalms.

decisions.choice: a verb without a subject (L), "essa pessoa" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in verse 2: Portuguese can leave out the subject (L) or say "essa pessoa" (B, R), which already includes anyone, so no gender span is needed where the English has "that person is|he is" and "they do|he does".

decisions.choice: "ተዛውሮ እንደ ተተከለ" (planted after being moved) and "የውኃ ቦዮች" (channels of water)
decisions.reason: The verb means transplanted, set out on purpose; the watercourses are dug channels that water an orchard (meaning decisions m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "रोपा गया" (L); "लगाया गया" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "रोपना" is said of a seedling set out in a chosen place, which keeps the sense of "transplanted" (meaning m1); Balanced and Readable use the everyday "लगाना".

decisions.choice: пересаженное (L); высаженное (B)
decisions.reason: The tree was planted on purpose where it would thrive (m1); Literal and Balanced keep that sense, Readable says simply "посаженное".

source.text: לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not so the wicked, but rather like the chaff which drives it away wind.

en.L: Not so the wicked, \q but [they are] like the chaff that wind drives away.
en.B: The wicked are nothing like that. \q They are like chaff, scattered by the wind.
en.R: Wicked people are not like that at all. \q They are like the dry husks of grain that the wind blows away.

vi.L: Không như vậy đối với kẻ ác, \q nhưng [chúng] như trấu mà gió thổi bay đi.
vi.B: Kẻ ác thì không như thế. \q Chúng như trấu bị gió cuốn đi.
vi.R: Kẻ ác hoàn toàn không như vậy. \q Chúng giống như vỏ trấu khô bị gió thổi bay mất.

ko.L: 그렇지 않다, 악인들은. \q [그들은] 오히려 바람이 몰아가는 겨와 같다.
ko.B: 악인들은 전혀 그렇지 않다. \q 그들은 바람에 흩어지는 겨와 같다.
ko.R: 악한 사람들은 결코 그렇지 않다. \q 그들은 바람에 날아가 버리는 마른 곡식 껍질과 같다.

fr.L: Pas ainsi les méchants, \q mais [ils sont] comme la paille que le vent emporte.
fr.B: Les méchants ne sont pas du tout ainsi : \q ils sont comme la balle que disperse le vent.
fr.R: Pour les méchants, c’est tout le contraire. \q Ils sont comme les enveloppes sèches des grains, que le vent emporte.

sw.L: Sivyo waovu, \q bali [wao ni] kama makapi ambayo upepo huyapeperusha.
sw.B: Waovu hawako hivyo hata kidogo. \q Wao ni kama makapi yanayotawanywa na upepo.
sw.R: Watu waovu si kama hivyo hata kidogo. \q Wao ni kama maganda makavu ya nafaka yanayopeperushwa na upepo.

es.L: No así los malvados, \q sino [que son] como la paja que el viento arrastra.
es.B: Los malvados no son nada así: \q son como paja que el viento dispersa.
es.R: Los malvados no son así para nada. \q Son como las cáscaras secas del grano que el viento se lleva.

pt.L: Não assim os ímpios, \q mas [são] como a palha que [o] vento leva.
pt.B: Os ímpios não são nada disso; \q são como palha, espalhada pelo vento.
pt.R: As pessoas más não são assim de jeito nenhum. \q São como a casca seca dos grãos, que o vento leva embora.

am.L: ክፉዎች እንዲህ አይደሉም፤ \q ነገር ግን ነፋስ እንደሚያባርረው ገለባ [ናቸው]።
am.B: ክፉዎች ግን እንደዚህ አይደሉም፤ \q ነፋስ እንደሚበትነው ገለባ ናቸው።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች ግን ፈጽሞ እንደዚህ አይደሉም። \q ነፋስ ወስዶ እንደሚበትነው የደረቀ የእህል ገለባ ናቸው።

hi.L: दुष्ट ऐसे नहीं, \q परन्तु [वे] उस भूसे के समान [हैं] जिसे हवा उड़ा ले जाती है।
hi.B: दुष्ट ऐसे बिलकुल नहीं हैं। \q वे भूसे के समान हैं, जिसे हवा उड़ा ले जाती है।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग ऐसे बिलकुल नहीं हैं। \q वे अनाज के सूखे छिलकों जैसे हैं, जिन्हें हवा उड़ा ले जाती है।

ru.L: Не таковы нечестивые, \q но [они] — как мякина, которую развевает ветер.
ru.B: Нечестивые совсем не такие. \q Они — как мякина, которую разносит ветер.
ru.R: Злые люди совсем не такие. \q Они как сухая шелуха от зерна, которую уносит ветер.

ja.L: 悪しき者たちは、そうではない。 \q [彼らは]風が吹き飛ばすもみ殻のようだ。
ja.B: 悪しき者たちは、そのようではない。 \q 彼らは、風に吹き散らされるもみ殻のようだ。
ja.R: 悪い人たちは、まったくそうではない。 \q 風に飛ばされていく、乾いた麦の殻のようだ。

uk.L: Не так нечестиві, \q а [вони] як полова, яку розвіює вітер.
uk.B: Нечестиві зовсім не такі. \q Вони — як полова, яку розносить вітер.
uk.R: Злі люди зовсім не такі. \q Вони як суха лушпина зерна, яку здуває вітер.

decisions.choice: chaff: the light husks blown off at threshing
decisions.reason: Grain was threshed and then tossed into the air on an open floor; the heavy grain fell back and the wind carried off the husks (Isaiah 41:15-16; Hosea 13:3). Chaff has no weight and no roots: the opposite of the tree of verse 3.

decisions.choice: Not so: the contrast comes first
decisions.reason: The verse opens with "not so", setting the wicked against everything said of the blessed person in verses 1-3.

decisions.choice: the dry husks of grain
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word, which many readers no longer know (m1).

decisions.choice: "trấu" (chaff), "vỏ trấu khô" (R)
decisions.reason: Rice husks blown away at winnowing are a picture every Vietnamese reader knows, and it is the same thing as the chaff of threshed grain: light, dry and worthless.

decisions.choice: "chúng" for the wicked
decisions.reason: "chúng" is the usual pronoun for the wicked in a psalm; it keeps them at a distance, as the contrast with the blessed person does. "họ" would be neutral.

decisions.choice: "그렇지 않다, 악인들은" with the subject after the predicate
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's order, where the contrast comes first (meaning decision); Korean allows a subject added after the verb in poetry.

decisions.choice: "la paille" (Literal), "la balle" (Balanced), "les enveloppes sèches des grains" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is the light husk blown away when grain is winnowed (m1). "La balle" is the exact French word but rare today, so Literal uses the common "la paille" and Readable describes it.

decisions.choice: a palha
decisions.reason: "Palha" is the word Brazilians know for the light husks blown off at threshing (m1); "moinha" is exact but little known, and "joio" is a weed, not chaff. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the wicked as "ክፉዎች" (L, B), "ክፉ ሰዎች" (R); at Literal "ኃጥኣን" only where they stand beside sinners (verses 1, 5)
decisions.reason: The terms list keeps "ክፉዎች" for the wicked and "ኃጥኣን" only where Literal pairs them with "ኃጢአተኞች" (sinners), so the two Hebrew words stay apart in those lines.

decisions.choice: "दुष्ट" (L, B); "दुष्ट लोग" (R)
decisions.reason: The wicked are "दुष्ट", as the poetry note settles, at every level; Readable adds "लोग" as the English says "wicked people".

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֤ן׀לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore not will rise wicked [people] in the judgment, and sinners in [the] assembly of righteous [people].

en.L: Therefore [the] wicked will not rise in the judgment, \q nor sinners in [the] assembly of [the] righteous.
en.B: That is why the wicked will not stand firm when judgment comes, \q and sinners will have no place in the gathering of the righteous.
en.R: So when God judges, wicked people will not be able to stand. \q Sinners will have no place among those who do what is right.

vi.L: Vì vậy kẻ ác sẽ không đứng lên trong cuộc phán xét, \q và kẻ tội lỗi [không đứng] trong hội của người công chính.
vi.B: Vì thế, khi sự phán xét đến, kẻ ác sẽ không đứng vững nổi, \q và kẻ tội lỗi sẽ không có chỗ trong hội của người công chính.
vi.R: Vậy khi Đức Chúa Trời phán xét, kẻ ác sẽ không đứng nổi. \q Kẻ có tội sẽ không có chỗ giữa những người sống ngay thẳng.

ko.L: 그러므로 악인들은 심판에서 일어서지 못하고, \q 죄인들은 의인들의 회중에서 [일어서지 못할 것이다].
ko.B: 그러므로 심판이 닥칠 때 악인들은 견디지 못하고, \q 죄인들은 의인들의 모임에 설 자리가 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 하나님께서 심판하실 때 악한 사람들은 버티지 못할 것이다. \q 죄인들은 바르게 사는 사람들 사이에 낄 자리가 없을 것이다.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi les méchants ne se relèveront pas au jugement, \q ni les pécheurs dans l’assemblée des justes.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi les méchants ne tiendront pas debout quand viendra le jugement, \q et les pécheurs n’auront pas de place dans le rassemblement des justes.
fr.R: Alors, quand Dieu jugera, les méchants ne pourront pas tenir. \q Les pécheurs n’auront pas de place parmi ceux qui font ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hiyo waovu hawatainuka katika hukumu, \q wala wenye dhambi katika mkutano wa wenye haki.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana waovu hawatasimama imara hukumu itakapokuja, \q na wenye dhambi hawatakuwa na nafasi katika jumuiya ya wenye haki.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Mungu atakapohukumu, waovu hawataweza kusimama. \q Wenye dhambi hawatakuwa na nafasi kati ya watu wanaotenda haki.

es.L: Por tanto, no se levantarán [los] malvados en el juicio, \q ni [los] pecadores en [la] asamblea de [los] justos.
es.B: Por eso los malvados no se mantendrán en pie cuando llegue el juicio, \q y los pecadores no tendrán lugar en la reunión de los justos.
es.R: Así que, cuando Dios juzgue, los malvados no podrán mantenerse en pie. \q Los pecadores no tendrán lugar entre los que hacen lo que es justo.

pt.L: Por isso [os] ímpios não se levantarão no julgamento, \q nem [os] pecadores na comunidade dos justos.
pt.B: É por isso que os ímpios não ficarão de pé quando vier o julgamento, \q e os pecadores não terão lugar na comunidade dos justos.
pt.R: Por isso, quando Deus julgar, as pessoas más não vão conseguir ficar de pé. \q Os pecadores não terão lugar entre os que fazem o que é certo.

am.L: ስለዚህ ኃጥኣን በፍርድ አይነሡም፤ \q ኃጢአተኞችም በጻድቃን ጉባኤ [አይነሡም]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ፍርድ በሚመጣበት ጊዜ ክፉዎች ጸንተው አይቆሙም፤ \q ኃጢአተኞችም በጻድቃን ጉባኤ ስፍራ አይኖራቸውም።
am.R: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በሚፈርድበት ጊዜ ክፉ ሰዎች መቆም አይችሉም። \q ኃጢአተኞችም ትክክል የሆነውን በሚያደርጉ ሰዎች መካከል ስፍራ አይኖራቸውም።

hi.L: इस कारण दुष्ट न्याय में नहीं उठेंगे, \q और न पापी धर्मियों की मंडली में।
hi.B: इसी कारण दुष्ट न्याय के समय टिक नहीं पाएँगे, \q और पापियों को धर्मियों की मंडली में कोई जगह नहीं मिलेगी।
hi.R: इसलिए जब परमेश्वर न्याय करेंगे, तब दुष्ट लोग टिक नहीं पाएँगे। \q पापियों को उन लोगों के बीच कोई जगह नहीं मिलेगी जो सही काम करते हैं।

ru.L: Поэтому не поднимутся нечестивые на суде, \q ни грешники — в общине праведных.
ru.B: Вот почему нечестивые не устоят, когда придёт суд, \q и грешникам не будет места в общине праведных.
ru.R: Поэтому, когда Бог будет судить, злые люди не смогут устоять. \q Грешникам не будет места среди тех, кто поступает правильно.

ja.L: それゆえ、悪しき者たちは裁きの中で立ち上がらず、 \q 罪人たちも、正しい者たちの会衆の中で[立ち上がらない]。
ja.B: だから、悪しき者たちは、裁きが来るときに立っていられず、 \q 罪人たちは、正しい人たちの集いに居場所がない。
ja.R: だから、神が裁かれるとき、悪い人たちは立っていられない。 \q 罪を犯す人たちは、正しいことをする人たちの中に、いる場所がない。

uk.L: Тому не встоять нечестиві на суді, \q ані грішники в громаді праведних.
uk.B: Ось чому нечестиві не встоять, коли настане суд, \q і грішникам не буде місця в громаді праведних.
uk.R: Тож коли Бог судитиме, злі люди не встоять. \q Грішникам не буде місця серед тих, хто чинить правильно.

decisions.choice: will not rise in the judgment: will not hold their ground when judged
alternatives: will not rise from the dead for the judgment
decisions.reason: To rise or stand in a court is to hold one's ground against the charge (compare Psalm 130:3: who could stand if the LORD kept a record of sins?). "The judgment" may be God's coming judgment or any time he judges. Some later readers took "rise" as rising from the dead, but the parallel line, about having no place in the assembly, shows the sense: the wicked will not keep their place.

decisions.choice: assembly: the gathered community of God's people
decisions.reason: The word ('edah) is used for Israel gathered as a community (Exodus 12:3; Numbers 27:17). Sinners will have no place there.

decisions.choice: the righteous: those who live rightly before God
decisions.reason: The righteous (tsaddiqim) are the people the psalm has described: those who live by the LORD's instruction, in contrast to the wicked and sinners.

decisions.choice: rise
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb's own sense; Balanced and Readable say "stand", the usual way of saying it (m1).

decisions.choice: when God judges
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the judge, which verse 6 implies, and Readable explains "the righteous" (m3).

decisions.choice: los justos
decisions.reason: The Hebrew tsaddiqim are those who live rightly before God. Literal and Balanced say "los justos", as in Proverbs; Readable says what they do, as the English Readable does. "Los malvados" stands for the wicked at every level.

decisions.choice: a comunidade
decisions.reason: "A comunidade" is the Old Testament terms' word for Israel gathered as a community ('edah, m2); "a assembleia" is kept for qahal.

decisions.choice: "धर्मियों की मंडली"
decisions.reason: The word is ʿedah, the gathered community of God's people (meaning m2), which the Pentateuch note renders "मंडली"; the righteous are "धर्मी". Readable explains them, as the English does (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: община
decisions.reason: The word (edah) is the gathered community of God's people (m2), "община" as in the Pentateuch; "собрание" is kept for qahal.

decisions.choice: tsaddiq "正しい者" (L), "正しい人" (B), R as the English Readable ("正しいことをする人"); 'edah "会衆" (L), "集い" (B), as the Psalter's forms
decisions.reason: Proverbs and Job settled 正しい者 / 正しい人 for the righteous; the 'edah here is God's gathered people (m2), so Literal keeps the Pentateuch's 会衆 and Balanced the plainer 集い.

decisions.choice: "праведні" (L, B), "ті, хто чинить правильно" (R) for the righteous, through the book
decisions.reason: "Праведний" is the Bible's word for one who lives rightly before God; Readable says what such people do, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For knowing [is] YHWH [the] way of righteous [people], and [the] way of wicked [people] will perish.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] knowing [the] way of [the] righteous, \q and [the] way of [the] wicked will perish.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} knows the path of the righteous and cares for it, \q but the path of the wicked ends in ruin.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches over the lives of those who do right. \q But the life wicked people live will end in ruin.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết đường lối của người công chính, \q và đường lối của kẻ ác sẽ tiêu vong.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết và chăm lo con đường của người công chính, \q còn con đường của kẻ ác sẽ dẫn đến diệt vong.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} luôn chăm lo cho cuộc đời của những người sống ngay thẳng. \q Còn lối sống của kẻ ác sẽ kết thúc trong tan nát.

ko.L: 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 의인들의 길을 알고 계시고, \q 악인들의 길은 망할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 의인들이 가는 길을 아시고 돌보시지만, \q 악인들의 길은 끝내 망하고 만다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 바르게 사는 사람들의 삶을 지켜보신다. \q 그러나 악한 사람들이 사는 방식은 결국 망하고 만다.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] connaissant [le] chemin des justes, \q et [le] chemin des méchants périra.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} connaît le chemin des justes et en prend soin, \q mais le chemin des méchants mène à la ruine.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur la vie de ceux qui font le bien. \q Mais la vie que mènent les méchants finira dans la ruine.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye kuijua njia ya wenye haki, \q na njia ya waovu itaangamia.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaijua njia ya wenye haki na kuitunza, \q lakini njia ya waovu huishia katika maangamizi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayalinda maisha ya watu wanaotenda haki. \q Lakini maisha ya waovu yataishia katika maangamizi.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} conoce [el] camino de [los] justos, \q pero [el] camino de [los] malvados perecerá.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} conoce el camino de los justos y lo cuida, \q pero el camino de los malvados acaba en la ruina.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuida la vida de los que hacen lo correcto. \q Pero la vida de los malvados terminará en la ruina.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [está] conhecendo [o] caminho dos justos, \q e [o] caminho dos ímpios perecerá.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} conhece a trilha dos justos e cuida dela, \q mas a trilha dos ímpios termina em ruína.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} protege a vida de quem faz o que é certo. \q Mas a vida que as pessoas más levam vai acabar em ruína.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የጻድቃንን መንገድ የሚያውቅ ነውና፤ \q የክፉዎች መንገድ ግን ይጠፋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የጻድቃንን መንገድ ያውቃል፤ ይጠብቀውማል፤ \q የክፉዎች መንገድ ግን ወደ ጥፋት ያመራል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉትን ሰዎች ሕይወት ይጠብቃል። \q ክፉ ሰዎች የሚኖሩት ሕይወት ግን በጥፋት ያልቃል።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} धर्मियों के मार्ग को जानते हैं, \q और दुष्टों का मार्ग नष्ट हो जाएगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} धर्मियों के मार्ग को जानते हैं और उसकी चिंता करते हैं, \q पर दुष्टों का मार्ग विनाश में समाप्त होता है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन लोगों के जीवन की रखवाली करते हैं जो सही काम करते हैं। \q पर दुष्ट लोग जैसा जीवन जीते हैं, उसका अंत विनाश है।

ru.L: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} [есть] знающий путь праведных, \q а путь нечестивых пропадёт.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} знает путь праведных и бережёт его, \q а путь нечестивых ведёт к гибели.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} хранит жизнь тех, кто поступает правильно. \q А жизнь злых людей закончится гибелью.

ja.L: なぜなら、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は正しい者たちの道を知っておられ、 \q 悪しき者たちの道は滅びるからである。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、正しい人たちの道を知り、心にかけておられる。 \q しかし、悪しき者たちの道は、滅びに至る。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、正しいことをする人たちの生き方を、見守っていてくださる。 \q しかし、悪い人たちの生き方は、滅びで終わる。

uk.L: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} знає дорогу праведних, \q а дорога нечестивих загине.
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} знає шлях праведних і дбає про нього, \q а шлях нечестивих веде до загибелі.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} пильнує життя тих, хто чинить правильно. \q А життя злих людей закінчиться загибеллю.

decisions.choice: knows: knows with care and approval
decisions.reason: To "know" in Hebrew is often to know personally, to care for and to choose (Nahum 1:7; Amos 3:2). The LORD does more than notice the way of the righteous; he looks after it. The psalm does not say he knows the way of the wicked: it simply perishes.

decisions.choice: way: a whole way of life
decisions.reason: The way (derek) is the path a person takes through life, as in verse 1 ("the way of sinners"). The psalm ends as it began, with two ways.

decisions.choice: will perish: the way itself comes to nothing
decisions.reason: It is the way of the wicked that perishes, like a path that fades out and leads nowhere. Psalm 2 picks up the same two words: those who defy the LORD "perish in the way" (2:12).

decisions.choice: knows ... and cares for it (B); watches over (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the care that "knows" means here (m1). Literal keeps the participle "knowing".

decisions.choice: path (B); lives, the life ... live (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "path", as in verse 1; Readable says what the path stands for (m2).

decisions.choice: the divine name as "CHÚA" in capitals, with "Gia-vê" as the setting's alternative
decisions.reason: The capitals mark the name YHWH, as "the LORD" does in English, and keep it apart from "Chúa" for Adonai. "Đức Giê-hô-va", the older Protestant form, is not used; "Gia-vê" gives the name as it was probably said.

decisions.choice: "BWANA" in capitals by default, "Yahwe" as the setting alternative
decisions.reason: As in the rest of the Old Testament: the capitals show that the Hebrew has the divine name here, and the reader may switch to the name itself. "Bwana" in ordinary letters is kept for the title Adonai, "Lord" (2:4).

decisions.choice: знает ... и бережёт (B); хранит жизнь (R)
decisions.reason: Knowing here is knowing with care (m1), and the way is a whole way of life (m2); Balanced keeps "путь" and adds the care, Readable says "жизнь", as the English does. Literal keeps the participle.
